Use case: style-transfer repaint of the NovelAI storyboard for 浪掷风吟.
REFERENCE ROLES: Image1 is the EDIT TARGET and sole authority for composition, action, wind path and WHITE BACKGROUND. Image2 is the owner's APPROVED hand-painted card finish: borrow painting language and refinement hierarchy only; do not copy its composition, moon/rain/background. Image3 is Xingyue's CHARACTER IDENTITY only; do not copy its pose or lantern.
LOCK THE DRAWING: Keep Image1's three-quarter low-angle waist/thigh crop, body leaning backward in song, head tilted up at upper right, softly closed eyes and open singing mouth, one hand resting naturally at heart, other arm extending toward lower left with relaxed palm upward. Preserve coherent shoulder/elbow/wrist connections and five readable fingers. Keep the long braid streaming left, cape flowing opposite torso tilt, dress continuing beyond bottom frame, and the large S-shaped pale wind stroke flowing from the foreground palm across her waist and around behind her head. Maintain proportions and exact positions of these major shapes.
BACKGROUND MUST STAY WHITE: Use Image1's clean solid WHITE background, fully opaque white, including all four corners and the open spaces around figure and wind. Do not add gray, teal, blue, green or cloudy painted backdrop, scenery, gray polygon patches or colored background wash. The white negative space is part of the design. The pale wind remains a distinct very light ivory/mint brush stroke against white, with a restrained colored shadow inside the wind itself, not a background color.
IDENTITY AND FACE: Young adult female Xingyue, pale gold hair with one side braid gathered into low ponytail, golden eyes when visible, delicate calm anime facial proportions, white crescent hairclip clipped flat/slanted above bangs on viewer-right, white priestess long dress and deep teal cape with restrained gold trim. Retain Image1 singing expression, drawing facial structure with the selective clarity and maturity of the approved Image2 face: nuanced eyelid arcs, economical nose/mouth, cheek/neck turning planes and hair-cast shadow, not a simplified doll face. Preserve readable relaxed hands with broad anatomy planes and a few essential joint marks.
PAINTING LANGUAGE: Match Image2's rough HAND-PAINTED ANIME finish. Build connected OPAQUE matte color masses with broad economical directional paint swipes, irregular short bands and curved wedges. Use decisive handmade light-shadow boundaries with slight edge variation and occasional broken overlap; a few subtle skin transitions are allowed. Broad grouped golden hair locks and substantial braided segments, with quiet base color and selected broad shadow/highlight bands instead of narrow strands. White dress retains shoulder, chest, elbow, waist and principal cloth-tension folds using broad gray-ivory shadow planes plus a few sparse colored structural lines. Teal cape has large connected light/dark planes and purposeful wider brush strokes, not featureless flat fill. Simplify gold trim into a few clear marks while preserving its physical placement. The wind uses one connected broad stroke with a few direction marks; keep its rhythm and negative space clear.
REFINEMENT HIERARCHY: Face and hand gesture most readable; hair, cape and principal dress folds moderately resolved; wind and white negative space economical. The image should look like a complete confident painted anime illustration with selective coarse regions, not a low-detail vector poster, paper-cut mosaic, smoothly outlined cel artwork or polished glossy fantasy image. No tiny hair filaments, dense wrinkles, triangular facet tiling, airbrushed shiny chiffon, thick oil paint ridges, random grain/scratches or texture overlay. Do not replace structural detail with broad flat polygons.
Single square illustration, no text, border, frame, watermark or UI.
